name: pull-refresh
title: Pull Refresh
description: Pull down to sync a file. A short pull cancels the gesture.
usage: <PullRefresh onRefresh={async () => { const result = await fetch("/api/status", { cache: "no-store" }); if (!result.ok) throw new Error("Refresh failed"); }} />
useCases: In a mobile recent-files panel, a teammate pulls down to refresh. The app requests fresh data in onRefresh.
After a connection drops, a user retries the sync with the button and reads its status to see whether the request completed.
task: Pull down to sync a file. A short pull cancels the gesture.
behavior: Return a Promise from onRefresh and update application data inside the handler. Rejection puts the control in its error state.
